name: Huaqin Co., Ltd.
summary: Huaqin Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and operation services of intelligent products in China and internationally. The company offers personal electronics, including smart phones, tablets, and laptops; smart wearables; VR and AR, smart speaker, smart door lock, and TV; automotive electronics comprising intelligent cabin, connection, driving, and vehicle control; commercial devices which include POS, mobile data collection terminals, intelligent door locks, intelligent speakers, smart office, industrial webcams, and edge computing; and general purpose servers, network switches, heterogeneous servers, and edge servers, as well as digital scenes.
